summary: IM Cannabis Corp. (IMC) filed a Form 6-K on June 18, 2026, announcing a non-binding Letter of Intent to sell its European-focused assets to Slil.com Holding Ltd., a company controlled by IMC's CEO Oren Shuster. The transaction involves the sale of IMC Holdings Ltd., which holds European operations including Adjupharm GmbH in Germany, Xinteza API Ltd., and Shiran Societe Anonyme. Consideration is Slil's assumption of approximately C$10.5 million of IMC's debt (C$7.5M in retained liabilities plus C$3M in short-term liabilities), representing a significant debt reduction for IMC. The Board formed a Special Committee of independent directors and commissioned Beta Finance T.Y.S Ltd. to prepare a fairness opinion. Post-closing, IMC will retain its Israeli operations. The transaction is subject to negotiation of a definitive agreement, regulatory clearances, and customary conditions. Watch for definitive agreement terms, special committee approval, and potential conflicts of interest given CEO involvement.
